title: events.v1
description: What every node did: restarts, health checks, index and cache events, jobs.

pairs.description: Kind pairs on different nodes with lift >= 3, by count; without job_run (see interactions.concurrent_jobs); at most 50. Computed before scheduled repeats are folded.

ClusterEvent.title: ClusterEvent
ClusterEvent.description: One event: a group matched by an event rule, repeats within a short time folded in.

last_ts.description: Time of its last entry (= ts when count is 1).

subject.description: What it is about: a node id, a health check, a lock, a job key.

subject_node.description: subject when it is a node of the capture.

signature.description: Group signature of the first entry.

entry_id.description: Id of the first entry (in the node's set).

text.description: Message of the first entry, at most 300 characters.

count.description: Entries folded into the event: same node, kind and subject within 60 s of the first (job_run 120 s, start and stop 10 min); health_failed and job_run also fold repeats at most 2 h (job_run 30 min) after the previous one.

EventPair.title: EventPair
EventPair.description: Events of kind a on node a followed within 60 s by events of kind b on node b.

b.description: The later event, on another node.

count.description: Events a followed by an event b.

median_lag_ms.description: Median time from a to the first b after it.

lift.description: count / expected, expected = of x min(1, events b x 60 s / window).

EventSide.title: EventSide
EventSide.description: One side of an event pair.
